source.title: You've Got Yourself A Deal
source.description: I've signed in the appropriate places, <name>. Take this back to Ratchet and inform your supplier that the Alliance is happy to do business.
source.objective: Return the Signed Procurement Contract to Grizzby in Ratchet.
source.completion:
They signed without even negotiating? Ha! Everything's turning around for ol' Grizzby!

And you, <name>, you've been a real pal. Here ya go, a little token of my thanks.

And now that we're officially in business, feel free to look through my stock of gear and see if anything catches your eye. I'll even give you the employee discount!
